title: LIST: Winning party, sectoral representatives in BARMM polls

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has released the list of winning representatives of the political parties and sectoral organizations in the first Bangsamoro Parliamentary elections.

The Comelec concluded the conduct of the elections on Tuesday evening after the electoral exercise resumed in Maluso, Basilan on Tuesday. The town experienced delays from flagging of pre-shaded ballots in its 36 out of 68 precincts.
The following political party representatives are allotted seats in the parliament after four parties breached the 2.5 percent threshold of needed votes for the party race.

In the 40-seat political party allocation in the parliament, Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP) was given 16 seats, 15 seats for United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP), eight for Bangsamoro Grand Coalition (BGC), and one for Raayat Democratic Party.

Meanwhile, the following secured seats in the sectoral organization race. In the 80-seat parliament, sectoral organizations are allotted eight seats, of which two each are given to the settler community and Non-Moro indigenous peoples (IPs), and one each for the sectors of women, youth, traditional leaders, and Ulama or Islamic scholars.
The remaining 32 seats in the parliament are allocated for district representatives. /jpv
